title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.1 (Peaked October 18, 2026 at 19:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 390 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Keeping watch. Nothing unusual. 👀✨🖤

Two small sunspot groups and a broad dark coronal structure are visible today, while the outer corona appears generally quiet.

Image: NASA SDO — AIA 171 Å + HMI Magnetic Polarity
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
